subject: Delivery timing
text: Thanks for checking. Quick change on our side: the site crew can only unload before noon today, so could the delivery slip to 9:30? Sorry for the scramble, but that window is tight. If 9:30 is no longer possible, please tell me what works soon. We can hold the gate open, and I’ll make sure someone is there to sign. Appreciate your help getting this sorted before the afternoon work starts.
